title: Addition of polynomial sharings
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $d\in\mathbb N$, and let $x,y\in F$ and $f,g$ be functions from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$. If $f$ shares $x$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d$ whose value at zero is $x$, and $g$ shares $y$ in the same way, then the pointwise sum $f+g$ shares $x+y$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d$.
hypotheses_covered: Share functions $f,g$ on nonzero elements of $F$
